description: This file contains functions for fetching stock data from Yahoo Finance, calculating trading statistics based on buy/sell logic, implementing a simple moving average (SMA) trading strategy, and a main program to run the strategy interactively.

methods.name: get_stock_data
methods.description: Fetches stock data from Yahoo Finance for a given stock symbol and date range.

methods.name: calculate_trading_statistics
methods.description: Calculates trading statistics based on buy/sell logic and optional additional logic.

methods.name: calculate_statistics_from_percent_change
methods.description: Computes various statistics from a list of percentage changes in stock prices.

methods.name: sma_strategy_logic
methods.description: Determines buy/sell signals based on SMA crossover strategy.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to execute the SMA trading strategy interactively.
